heading: What California's C-36 license covers

items.label: C-36 scope
items.text: CSLB's C-36 Plumbing Contractor classification reads:
items.quote: A plumbing contractor provides a means for a supply of safe water, ample in volume and of suitable temperature for the purpose intended and the proper disposal of fluid waste from the premises in all structures and fixed works.

items.label: Gases and liquids
items.quote: Piping, storage tanks and venting for a safe and adequate supply of gases and liquids for any purpose, including vacuum, compressed air and gases for medical, dental, commercial and industrial uses

items.label: From the meter
items.quote: Water and gas piping from the property owner's side of the utility meter to the structure or fixed works
